metadata.title: Dashboard Widgets - Residents and Households Summary

story.iWant: see key statistics about residents and households on my dashboard
story.soThat: I have quick visibility into community composition
story.tasks:
**Task 1: Create CommunityOverviewWidget component (AC: 1, 4, 5, 6)** - Create `src/components/dashboard/CommunityOverviewWidget.vue` following existing widget patterns - Add QCard structure with header "Community Overview" - Implement loading state with QSkeleton (3 rectangular placeholders) - Implement section-specific empty states ("No residents yet", "No households yet", "No types to display", "No recent additions") - Add responsive grid layout using Quasar row/col system (col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-4 patterns) - Use Quasar theme colors for visual consistency (primary, secondary, accent, positive info, grey)
**Task 2: Implement residents count display (AC: 1, 2)** - Add residents-store integration: import useResidentsStore - Create computed property `totalResidents` reading from store pagination.total - Display total residents count with icon (person icon) and large number (text-h4) - Add "View All Residents" link button with arrow icon navigating to `/residents` - Ensure count updates when store refreshes (reactive computed property)
**Task 3: Implement households count display (AC: 1, 2)** - Add households-store integration: import useHouseholdsStore - Create computed property `totalHouseholds` reading from store pagination.total - Display total households count with icon (home icon) and large number (text-h4) - Add "View All Households" link button with arrow icon navigating to `/households` - Ensure count updates when store refreshes (reactive computed property)
**Task 4: Implement households by type breakdown (AC: 1, 2, 5)** - Create computed property `householdsByType` aggregating household types from store - Use QList to display household types with QChip (colored by type) and QBadge (count) - Implement `getTypeColor()` function mapping types to Quasar theme colors: - Single Family → primary - Multi-Family → secondary - Dormitory → accent - Guest House → positive - Admin Building → info - Other → grey - Sort types by count descending for better visibility - Add QSeparator between list and total count section
**Task 5: Implement recent additions display (AC: 1, 2)** - Fetch 5 most recent residents using residentsStore.fetchResidents(1, 5) to get last 5 created (store already sorts by $createdAt desc) - Display in QList with resident name, household name (enriched), and relative creation date - Use relative time formatting (date-fns or Day.js) for "Added 2 days ago" display - Show section empty state "No residents added yet" if residents array is empty - Ensure list updates when new residents are created (reactive to store changes)
**Task 6: Integrate widget into DashboardPage (AC: 4)** - Import CommunityOverviewWidget into `src/pages/dashboard/DashboardPage.vue` - Add widget to dashboard grid with col-12 col-md-6 responsive classes - Position widget logically in grid (after Quick Stats, before/alongside other widgets) - Test responsive layout on mobile (320px), tablet (768px), desktop (1920px)
**Task 7: Implement data fetching on mount (AC: 2)** - Add onMounted lifecycle hook to fetch residents and households data - Call residentsStore.fetchResidents(1, 100) to get counts (pagination total) - Call householdsStore.fetchHouseholds(1, 100) to get counts and types - Set loading state during fetch, clear after completion - Handle errors gracefully with useErrorHandler composable
**Task 8: Testing and responsive validation (AC: 3, 4)** - Test widget display on desktop (1920px+): full breakdown and counts visible - Test widget display on tablet (768px+): stacked layout, all content accessible - Test widget display on mobile (320px minimum): vertical stack, readable text sizes - Test "View All" navigation links to `/residents` and `/households` - Test real-time updates: create resident/household, verify widget refreshes counts - Test empty states: verify section-specific empty messages display correctly - Test loading state: slow connection simulation, verify skeletons display

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Dashboard displays "Community Overview" widget with: total residents count, total households count, households by type chart recent additions 2. Widget updates in real-time when residents/households are added/edited (widget fetches fresh data from stores) 3. Click "View All" links navigate to respective list pages (`/residents` for residents, `/households` for households) 4. Widget is responsive and displays correctly on mobile devices (320px+), tablet (768px+), and desktop (1920px+) 5. Chart colors follow Quasar theme for visual consistency (primary, secondary, accent, positive, info, grey) 6. Widget shows placeholder message if no data exists (empty state with icon and helpful text)

doc.title: Epic 1 - Story 1.10 Definition
doc.snippet: Story 1.10 defines Community Overview widget scope: total residents, total households, households by type breakdown, recent additions, real-time updates responsive design.

doc.title: FR-1 and FR-2: Residents and Households Management
doc.snippet: Core modules requiring dashboard visibility. FR-1 specifies residents management with RBAC. FR-2 specifies households management with multiple types and occupant tracking.

doc.title: UX Principle #7: Role-Based Contextual Dashboards
doc.snippet: Each role sees personalized dashboard showing only relevant information and actions. Avoid one-size-fits-all dashboards that overwhelm users.

doc.title: UX Principle #9: Data Visualization Over Tables
doc.snippet: Prefer charts, graphs, and visual indicators over dense data tables. Show trends visually. Use progress bars for goals.

doc.title: Flow 1: Farm Manager Dashboard Patterns
doc.snippet: Dashboard widgets display at-a-glance insights with "View All" links for navigation. Widgets use QCard with loading states, data display, and action buttons.

doc.title: Dashboard Widget Design Patterns
doc.snippet: Loading states (QSkeleton), empty states (QIcon + message), color-coded indicators, responsive layouts (col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-4 patterns).

doc.title: Technology Stack
doc.snippet: Vue 3 `\u003cscript setup\u003e` syntax, Quasar Framework components, Pinia stores, Chart.js for data visualization (note: Story 1.10 uses QList/QChip/QBadge, not Chart.js).

story-context.constraints:
**Development Patterns:** - Use Vue 3 `\u003cscript setup\u003e` syntax (Composition API) - no export default - Follow HouseholdsWidget.vue pattern for consistency: QCard wrapper, loading skeleton, empty state, "View All" action button - Use Quasar components: QCard, QList, QItem, QChip, QBadge, QBtn, QIcon, QSkeleton - Responsive classes: col-12 (mobile), col-md-6 (tablet), col-lg-4 (desktop)
**Data Fetching Strategy:** - NO new store actions needed - use existing fetchResidents() and fetchHouseholds() - Use pagination.total for accurate counts (NOT households.length which is paginated) - Call store fetch methods in onMounted to populate counts - For recent residents: residentsStore.fetchResidents(1, 5) - store already sorts by $createdAt desc
**Widget Display Pattern:** - Use QList + QChip + QBadge for household types display (NOT Chart.js) - Chart.js deferred to future analytics features per architecture decision - Section-specific empty states: "No residents yet", "No households yet", "No types to display", "No recent additions" - NOT a single widget-level empty state
**Color Consistency:** - Use Quasar theme colors: primary, secondary, accent, positive, info, grey - Follow HouseholdsWidget getTypeColor() mapping for household types
**Error Handling:** - Use useErrorHandler composable for consistent error messaging - Pattern: const { notifyError, notifySuccess } = useErrorHandler()
**Responsive Design:** - Follow Quasar responsive breakpoints: col-12 (mobile), col-md-6 (tablet+), col-lg-4 (desktop) - Grid auto-adjusts based on viewport - Test at: 320px minimum (mobile), 768px+ (tablet), 1920px+ (desktop)
**Real-Time Updates:** - Widget should be reactive to store changes - Use computed properties referencing store state (NOT local cached data) - When new resident/household created, widget automatically refreshes via reactive computed properties

interface.name: useResidentsStore.fetchResidents
interface.signature: async fetchResidents(page = 1, limit = 10): Promise<{ success: boolean, data: Array, error?: string }>
interface.notes: Returns { success, data } where data is array of residents. Updates store.pagination.total with accurate count. Automatically sorts by Query.orderDesc('$createdAt'). Enriches residents with household names via enrichResidentsWithHouseholdNames().

interface.name: useResidentsStore.pagination
interface.signature: { currentPage: number, itemsPerPage: number, total: number }
interface.notes: pagination.total contains accurate total count from server (not affected by limit). Use this for total residents count display.

interface.name: useHouseholdsStore.fetchHouseholds
interface.signature: async fetchHouseholds(page = 1, limit = 10): Promise<{ success: boolean, data: Array, error?: string }>
interface.notes: Returns { success, data } where data is array of households with household_type field. Updates store.pagination.total. Enriches with occupant counts.

interface.name: useErrorHandler
interface.signature: { handleError: Function, notifyError: Function, notifySuccess: Function }
interface.notes: Consistent error/success notification handling. notifyError(message), notifySuccess(message) use Quasar Notify plugin.

interface.name: Quasar Components
interface.signature: QCard, QCardSection, QCardActions, QList, QItem, QItemSection, QItemLabel, QChip, QBadge, QBtn, QIcon, QSkeleton, QSeparator
interface.notes: Import from 'quasar'. All components used in HouseholdsWidget pattern. QSkeleton for loading states. QIcon with size="48px" color="grey-5" for empty states.

tests.standards: Manual testing documented in docs/testing.md following established format. Test cases include: widget display on multiple screen sizes (320px mobile, 768px tablet, 1920px desktop), data fetching and count accuracy, real-time updates when residents/households created, empty states for each section, navigation link functionality, responsive layout behavior. No automated tests in MVP per architecture decision (TypeScript and testing post-MVP).
tests.locations: docs/testing.md (manual test cases), future automated tests will be in src/tests/ when TypeScript is adopted post-MVP
tests.ideas:
**AC1 - Widget Display:** - Test: Display "Community Overview" widget with all sections - Verify: Total residents count (large number with person icon), total households count (large number with home icon), households by type list (QChip + QBadge), recent additions list (5 most recent) - Expected: All sections visible and properly formatted
**AC2 - Real-Time Updates:** - Test: Create new resident via Residents page - Verify: Return to dashboard, Community Overview widget shows updated count - Expected: Total residents incremented by 1, resident appears in recent additions - Test: Create new household via Households page - Verify: Return to dashboard, widget shows updated household count and type breakdown - Expected: Total households incremented, type breakdown updated
**AC3 - Navigation Links:** - Test: Click "View All Residents" button - Verify: Navigates to /residents page - Expected: Residents list page displayed - Test: Click "View All Households" button - Verify: Navigates to /households page - Expected: Households list page displayed
**AC4 - Responsive Design:** - Test: View widget at 1920px+ (desktop) - Expected: Full breakdown and counts visible side-by-side - Test: View widget at 768px+ (tablet) - Expected: Stacked layout, all content accessible, no horizontal scroll - Test: View widget at 320px (mobile minimum) - Expected: Vertical stack, readable text sizes, touch-friendly buttons
**AC5 - Color Consistency:** - Test: View households by type breakdown - Verify: Each household type uses correct Quasar theme color per getTypeColor() mapping - Expected: Single Family (primary blue), Multi-Family (secondary purple), Dormitory (accent teal), Guest House (positive green), Admin Building (info cyan), Other (grey)
**AC6 - Empty States:** - Test: Wipe all residents data - Verify: Widget displays section-specific empty states - Expected: "No residents yet" for residents section, "No recent additions" for recent list - Test: Wipe all households data - Verify: Widget displays households empty state - Expected: "No households yet", "No types to display" for type breakdown
**Error Handling:** - Test: Simulate network error during data fetch - Verify: Error notification displayed (via useErrorHandler) - Expected: User-friendly error message, widget shows empty state gracefully
**Loading State:** - Test: Slow connection simulation (network throttling) - Verify: Loading skeletons display during data fetch - Expected: 3 rectangular QSkeleton placeholders visible, replaced with data when loaded
